analysis: Integration pass over units 84-98 plus replayed docs/changelog patches. Production change: Gemma 4 loop-exit-thinking. GenerationLoopGuard records tokens and follows the thought channel. The scheduler (MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngine.swift, ~1024-1173) holds the guard's length terminal, waits up to 5s for row release, and submits one continuation row ('-exit' id) on the same bridge. The continuation reuses requestCacheScope/cacheEnabled (coordinator-authored cacheSalt, T-041 unchanged in kind). It is gated to non-distributed, non-logprobs rows; a nil bridge fails closed. Budget is clamped to the output budget minus tokens produced, with an 8192 cap. Docs say usage is summed as one completion, and that cancel propagates to both rows. Also new: the LaunchAgent passthrough allowlist adds DARKBLOOM_LOOP_GUARD and DARKBLOOM_LOOP_EXIT_THINKING, which are inference tuning toggles only. The operator is ADV-001 and already controls the environment, and the App Attest worker opt-in allowlist is unchanged. The cluster stopsAsked counter (ClusterSetupWizardStore, docs) is a leader-local count carried in the status reply. The reply is not visible in this batch and carries no secrets. The remaining changes are version bump 0.10.13, test files (cluster onboarding, MiMo hook-driven waits), and docs. No concrete regression is established. Unverified contracts, not findings: (1) the continuation submitTokenized omits tokenConstraint and usage/service-reservation fields. The docs say the guard is skipped for constrained, forced-tool and JSON requests, but GenerationLoopExitThinkingPolicy.resolve and the guard policy were not supplied, so I could not confirm exit-thinking is also skipped there. (2) Billing and usage accounting of the continuation row and its service allowance. (3) Whether the production stopsAsked/stopsBefore handling (OnboardingLive.recordStop, ClusterControlReply) can be spoofed by a peer. (4) Whether the test-only hook setMediaReservationRemovalHookForTesting is compiled out of release builds. (5) Log content of the loop-guard exit-thinking outcome string. Omitted replay units (281) and the truncated patch were not reviewed.
